column1: # remedies.tsv: decision options per upgrade blocker (RM). Read by bin/remedy.py (steps/remedy.md).
# One row per option. Rows with the same key make one decision card. key 'generic-*' rows apply only to a blocker no
# specific key matched; {subject} is the module, rung or row of that blocker. match: Python regex (search) on the
# blocker text (kept: / release: / smoke: / journeys: / rung: / replacement: / dojo: / finding: lines, see remedy.py).
# jump: any | to:<X | to:>=X (comma list, all must hold). option: A keep or pin, B swap (B2, B3 more swaps), C rebuild,
# D stay on the source version. effort S|M|L. mode AUTO-TRY (only A or B, with apply and regate) or HUMAN.
# verified: yes (...) | partial (...) | no | - | disproven (<the evidence>). remedy.py ranks options by it (RT-1): yes first,
# disproven last, then effort; the letter only breaks a tie. AUTO-TRY needs verified yes or partial (no or -: remedy.py makes it HUMAN;
# partial ranks behind every verified option); a disproven row is never AUTO-TRY; a C may be AUTO-TRY only with verified yes (a proven mechanical fix, not a rebuild).
# regate: gate rungs for gate.sh --only, plus the pseudo-rung eye for a visual symptom (RT-6): remedy_apply.sh stops for a
# by-eye look at the shots, and a tried PASS needs eye=<shot path>. A test that names keptdeps makes AUTO-TRY wait for a
# clean keptdeps run on the subject's kept dependents (RT-8).
